totpURI.description: TOTP URI for authenticator app setup. Only present when method is 'totp'.

backupCodes.description: Recovery backup codes. Only present when method is 'totp'.

metadata.description: Use this endpoint to disable two factor authentication.
Sign in with username

callbackURL.description: URL to redirect to after sign in (also used as the redirect target for email verification when required)

redirect.description: Whether the client should follow the Location header. True when callbackURL was provided.

token.description: Session token for the authenticated session

url.description: The callbackURL echoed back so the client can redirect.
